title: skills.sql
content:
-- Technical skills from Hongzhe Xie's current resume

CREATE TABLE technical_skills (
    category VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
    skills   TEXT[] NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO technical_skills (category, skills) VALUES
('Languages',
 ARRAY['Python', 'C/C++', 'Go', 'TypeScript/JavaScript', 'SQL']),

('AI & Agent Engineering',
 ARRAY['Google ADK', 'Gemini', 'Amazon Bedrock', 'Agent orchestration',
       'Structured tool/API calling', 'Multimodal pipelines',
       'LLM application security']),

('Application & Identity Security',
 ARRAY['API security', 'Phishing detection', 'WebAuthn/FIDO2', 'TOTP/MFA',
       'JWT/OAuth', 'RBAC/Casbin', 'CSRF/XSS/SSRF mitigation',
       'Rate limiting', 'Audit logging']),

('Security Testing & Tooling',
 ARRAY['CodeQL', 'Bandit', 'Trivy', 'Gitleaks', 'OSV', 'Safety', 'Postman',
       'SAST', 'Dependency scanning', 'Container scanning', 'Secret scanning']),

('Backend & Data',
 ARRAY['Django/DRF', 'Celery', 'Redis', 'PostgreSQL', 'MySQL', 'DynamoDB',
       'GORM', 'REST APIs']),

('Frontend & Testing',
 ARRAY['React', 'Vue.js', 'Vite', 'Playwright', 'Django testing',
       'End-to-end testing']),

('Cloud & DevOps',
 ARRAY['AWS ECS Fargate', 'Amplify', 'S3', 'SES', 'CloudWatch', 'GCP',
       'Docker', 'Nginx', 'GitHub Actions', 'CI/CD', 'SSH']);

SELECT category, array_length(skills, 1) AS skill_count, skills
FROM technical_skills
ORDER BY category;
